Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Anjali Natarajan. I am a 71-year-old architect living in Kochi. Patil Traders gave me a cheque for ₹31,30,000 to repay a loan, but the cheque came back with the remark account closed. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 67813 62211 or email anjali.natarajan@example.in.
